facility_roles.quote: currently under construction at the ultracold neutron source at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI)

intervals.label: under construction at the PSI ultracold neutron source
intervals.note: Start is the date of the design report, which says the experiment is "currently under construction"; the construction start itself is not stated. End: first use of the n2EDM apparatus for ultracold-neutron measurements (arXiv:2511.06884, 10 Nov 2025).
intervals.quote: We present the design of a next-generation experiment, n2EDM, currently under construction at the ultracold neutron source at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI)

intervals.label: commissioning
intervals.note: Start is a lower bound (the first paper using the apparatus for UCN measurements, 10 November 2025); the January 2026 paper says the experiment "is currently being commissioned". The active magnetic shield was commissioned in 2021 (same paper). No EDM result has been published.
intervals.quote: which is currently being commissioned at the ultracold neutron (UCN) source

physics_goals.quote: is expected to deliver an order of magnitude better sensitivity with provision for further substantial improvements
physics_goals.value: Carry out a high-precision search for an electric dipole moment of the neutron with an order of magnitude better sensitivity than the previous apparatus

summary.plain: The next-generation neutron electric-dipole-moment experiment at the Paul Scherrer Institute, aimed at an order of magnitude better sensitivity than its predecessor. It uses two stacked storage chambers and a huge magnetically shielded room, and is being commissioned.
summary.technical: n2EDM at the PSI UCN source: double-chamber Ramsey spectrometer (two vertically stacked UCN storage chambers) in a very large magnetically shielded room with an active magnetic shield and Hg/Cs magnetometry; goal an order of magnitude better sensitivity than the PSI nEDM apparatus (operated until 2017). Design report 2021; commissioning as of January 2026.
